description: Change how this organization's AI clients write: 'approve' files every change for a person to approve, 'direct' executes immediately. Owner or admin via OAuth only; API keys cannot call this. Without confirm=true nothing changes and the response previews the change. Direct mode reverts after duration_hours (default 24) unless permanent=true; allow_destructive adds session and sponsor deletes, allow_comms lets email and portal invites send unapproved. Admins are notified of every change. Returns status preview (current, proposed, message) or executed (the settings now in effect).

allow_comms.description: Also let send_email, speaker messages, reminders, and portal invites go out without approval.

allow_destructive.description: Also allow delete_session and delete_sponsor. Deletes are always notified and restorable from AI activity.

confirm.description: false or absent: return a preview only, change nothing. true: apply the change.

duration_hours.description: How long direct mode stays on before reverting to approvals (default 24). Ignored for mode approve; mutually exclusive with permanent.

event.description: Scope the change to one event (Convex event id from list_events) instead of the whole organization; other events keep the org default.

mode.description: approve: writes wait for human approval. direct: writes execute immediately.

org.description: Organization slug from list_my_orgs; only needed if you belong to several.

permanent.description: Keep direct mode on until turned off instead of expiring. Mutually exclusive with duration_hours.

request_id.description: Unique id you generate for this write (e.g. a UUID). A retry with the same id returns the first outcome instead of a duplicate; never reuse it for different arguments.

name: set_write_access

directComms.description: Whether email and invites send without approval.

directDestructive.description: Whether AI clients may delete without approval.

eventId.description: Event id when the change was scoped to one event.

noop.description: True when the requested settings were already in effect.

replayed.description: True for a stored outcome replayed for the same request_id.

status.description: preview: nothing changed (confirm was not true). executed: the setting was applied.

writeMode.description: approve or direct, after the change.

writeModeExpiresAt.description: When direct mode reverts to approvals (epoch ms), or null when permanent or approve.
